title: Jonah and the Witness
author: Gideon Blackwood
blurb: Lena Underhill, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
